physicalNotes: Radius 0.0228 solar radii from González-Santamaría et al. (2021), A&A 656, A51, Table 8: log(L/Lsun) = 1.79 from the star's V magnitude at its Gaia EDR3 distance, and log(Teff) = 5.03; the paper prints no radius, and 0.0228 solar radii is the sphere that radiates that luminosity at that temperature (Stefan-Boltzmann law) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12114): 15,862 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 107200 K from González-Santamaría et al. (2021), A&A 656, A51, Table 8: log(Teff) = 5.03, a temperature from the literature the paper compiles; spectral type DAO.5 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12114). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
